text:
alice: Postmortem follow-up: need clear owners and JIRA links for the remaining action items from last week's outage. Focus: remediation for cache-thrash, rollout checklist, and recurrence analysis.
ben: I can own the cache fix + regression evals. Will open ticket.
carla: I'll take the rollout checklist and docs updates; will also prepare the canary checklist.
diane: Assigning pattern analysis to Evan as he already looked at logs. Diane will review SRE implications.
ev an: I'll produce the log queries and bind them to the ticket. Also will summarize the two prior incidents I found.
pm-bot: Jira RW-3621 created by @ben - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-3621
ben: RW-3621: Fix - reduce kv cache retention + add eviction backpressure. Assignee: ben. Target: PR by 2026-04-01.
carla: RW-3622 created for docs/runbook by @carla - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-3622
diane: Please include acceptance criteria: no cache growth >15% under synthetic load for 24h; canary stability 48h.
ben: Adding ACs to RW-3621. Eval prompt I'll use: generate broad-context sequences, measure kv_cache_size, and ensure stable memory.
evan: Grep commands I used (attach to ticket):
`zgrep "kv_cache_size" /var/log/* | sort -k3 -n | tail -n 50`
`awk '/eviction/ || /oom/ {print $0}' /var/log/incidents.log | sed -n '1,200p'`
alice: Evan, please attach the snippet outputs and link incidents 2026-02-18 and 2026-03-12 in the ticket.
evan: Done, attached to RW-3621 -> Diagnostics. Linked RW-3470 and RW-3509.
carla: Proposed RACI for RW-3621/RW-3622: Ben=R, Carla=A, Evan=C, Alice=I, Diane=C. I'll paste a tiny table in each ticket.
ben: I'll keep code ownership and coordinate reviews. Carla, ping me when runbook draft ready so I can validate rollout steps for canary.
pm-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync RW-3621 scheduled 2026-03-28 10:00 UTC
alice: Let's meet at that time to close open items; aim to resolve all follow-ups by 2026-04-05.
ben: ack :thumbsup:
carla: ack
